create_HfTokenizer_from_directory: create an HfTokenizer instance from a model directory containing tokenizer.json and tokenizer_config.json
encode_text_to_tokens: encode a string into a list of token IDs using the HfTokenizer encode method
decode_tokens_to_text: decode a list of token IDs back into a string using the HfTokenizer decode method
encode_dialog_with_chat_template: encode a multi-turn dialog into tokens using the Jinja2 chat template from tokenizer config
get_stop_tokens_and_vocab_size: get the EOS stop token IDs and vocabulary size from an HfTokenizer instance
